title: DualOPSD: Adaptive Privileged Teachers for On-Policy Self-Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2608.26019v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) uses a privileged copy of the student model to provide dense supervision without an external teacher. OPSD keeps this privileged teacher fixed, even though the student distribution and output style change during training. We propose DualOPSD, an asymmetric alternating framework that adapts both policies. The student first learns from the privileged teacher. The teacher then moves toward the updated student distribution on the same student trajectory. This update makes later supervision responsive to the learner and does not require another rollout. On Qwen3-8B in non-thinking mode, DualOPSD improves avg@12 over OPSD by 23.61, 13.89, and 10.00 points on AIME 2024, AIME 2025, and HMMT 2025. Results at 1.7B and 4B show that the accuracy gain depends on model scale. Across all three scales, DualOPSD reduces truncation. The 4B diagnostic also shows lower KL in both directions between the teacher and student.

translated_title: DualOPSD：用于策略内自蒸馏的自适应特权教师
translated_abstract: 策略内自蒸馏（OPSD）使用学生模型的特权副本提供密集监督，无需外部教师。OPSD在训练过程中保持该特权教师固定不变，尽管学生分布和输出风格会发生变化。我们提出了DualOPSD，一种非对称交替框架，可自适应调整两种策略。学生首先从特权教师学习，然后教师在同一学生轨迹上向更新后的学生分布移动。这一更新使后续监督对学习者更具响应性，且无需额外展开。在非思考模式的Qwen3-8B上，DualOPSD在AIME 2024、AIME 2025和HMMT 2025上将avg@12分别比OPSD提升了23.61、13.89和10.00分。在1.7B和4B规模上的结果表明，准确率提升依赖于模型规模。在所有三个规模上，DualOPSD均减少了截断现象。4B诊断还显示教师与学生之间的KL散度在两个方向上都更低。
tldr: DualOPSD通过交替更新特权教师和学生，使教师适应学生分布变化，显著提升策略内自蒸馏的准确率并减少截断。
en_tdlr: DualOPSD alternately updates the privileged teacher and student to adapt the teacher to the student's evolving distribution, significantly improving accuracy and reducing truncation in on-policy self-distillation.
